g.text: record root id, dependency id, and version
assemble flat Tools and nested Agents
A null binding version selects the latest definition.
A non-null version requires an exact id-version match.
The current Agent table cannot return historical versions.
Bound Agent definitions do not recursively expand bindings.
Tool SQL and Tool version storage are owned by the Tool module.
The Agent module defines only the batch Mapper contract in this phase.
